flora: Oak-like leaf (ovate with serrated or shallowly lobed edges, leathery texture)
Proto-acorn (small, cup-shaped nut with a textured base cap)
Oak-like sapling (thick, sturdy stem with a rugged leading bud)
Bark detail (rough, corky, and deeply fissured with a grey-brown tone)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the rugged, 'corky' texture of the bark; tactile feel for the nut-caps; clear quadrant separation for educational study.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single serrated leaf; Top-Right: A cluster of small proto-acorns; Bottom-Left: A sturdy young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the rough, fissured grey bark.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, packed muddy grey earth with scattered tan silt and small pebbles.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to emphasize the 3D depth of the bark fissures and the texture of the acorn caps.
